verdict.rationale: Docs confirm cards (virtual and physical) can be issued via the API immediately after signup and tied to an account, with real-time authorization webhooks and 3DS support providing some spend-control capability (increase-docs-19, increase-docs-40, increase-docs-15, increase-docs-20, increase-docs-16). However, there is no evidence of built-in spend-limit/velocity controls as a distinct feature or of digital wallet (Apple Pay/Google Pay) provisioning support. Missing for 10: explicit spend-limit/control configuration API, digital wallet tokenization/support, independent corroboration of card issuance in production use.
